_schema.note: Battles and pivotal events. 'timeline_hint' is relative ordering only; the four POVs overlap.

entries.name: Fall of the Far Lands Civilization
entries.outcome: The Mafia overran the civilization in minutes; the Warriors Council ended.

entries.name: Unstable SMP: The First War
entries.outcome: Parrot and Theo meet; Parrot rises in the Warriors District.

entries.name: Spawn torn down for the Mafia prison
entries.outcome: New players forced to join the Mafia.

entries.name: Spawn prison break-in
entries.outcome: Found where pearls were transported in order to destroy the Mafia.

entries.name: Roshambo's flower farm bombing
entries.outcome: Spoke realises Ash betrayed them.

entries.name: The End of the Minecraft Mafia
entries.outcome: Season 1 finale; the Mafia falls; Spoke spares Ash.

entries.name: PrinceZam betrays Wemmbu
entries.outcome: Wemmbu's Civilization griefed; declares independence; Wemmbu develops trust issues.

entries.name: Orbital Strike Cannon detonated against Zam
entries.outcome: Escalation ends with ClownPierce imprisoning both.

entries.name: ClownPierce imprisons Wemmbu and Zam
entries.outcome: Forced cooperation; partial reconciliation.

entries.name: Battle of the Zam Empire
entries.outcome: Zam Empire dissolves.

entries.name: Jaden holds Eggchan hostage
entries.outcome: Egg surrenders his gear.

entries.name: Jaden's castle explodes
entries.outcome: Wemmbu and Egg escape; Theo reveals himself; Jaden flees down a tunnel.

entries.name: Lomedy gives Flame a mace
entries.outcome: Flame survives skilled attackers.

entries.name: Assault on the toxic base
entries.outcome: Lomedy's TNT cannons bombard; Flame kills everyone and beats the leader 1v1.

entries.name: Farm War
entries.outcome: Flame fights in netherite armor without weapons.

entries.name: Wemmbu vs Flame (Power Arc)
entries.outcome: Flame runs; Wemmbu declares himself the strongest.

entries.name: Parrot unmasks the Invisible Knight
entries.outcome: Wemmbu captured by the Law; vendetta against Parrot.

entries.name: Parrot's trap for Wemmbu and Flame
entries.outcome: Both trapped in an inescapable cell.

entries.name: Election for King
entries.outcome: Lettuce bribes candidates; Parrot refuses.

entries.name: Execution of Spepticle
entries.outcome: Executed in Parrot's place.

entries.name: Deputy_Ace frees Parrot and Theo
entries.outcome: Ace killed by SargeLAW.

entries.name: War of the LAW — final battle
entries.outcome: Lettuce surrenders; spared by vote (Wemmbu).

entries.name: Parrot becomes the first King
entries.outcome: Restarted election won.

entries.name: Spoke Galactic Empire founded
entries.outcome: 1,000-player army.

entries.name: Skymore massacre
entries.outcome: 999 of 1,000 settlers killed.

entries.name: Battle of Fort Feather
entries.outcome: Ground assault repelled; blimp paratroopers take the fort; Royal legion retreats by tunnel to Merchant City; Parrot detonates TNT.

entries.name: Battle of Merchant City
entries.outcome: ShoeBilly maces defenders until Cindercrest retreats.

entries.name: Wemmbu vs ShoeBilly at Steampunk City
entries.outcome: Webs and stab shots break ShoeBilly's helmet; parts of the city destroyed.

entries.name: Arachnid's pit betrayal
entries.outcome: Wemmbu survives with a Golden Apple and a Totem.

entries.name: Reina kidnapped
entries.outcome: Reina taken near the end of the war.

entries.name: Battle for Capital City
entries.outcome: Evacuation; orbital nuke shot kills hundreds of innocents; Wemmbu betrays Cindercrest and annihilates thousands; Royal Army defects; Saparata beats Parrot in a duel; decisive Cindercrest victory; Spawn captured.

entries.name: Royal Army defects
entries.outcome: Parrot's own army turns on him.

entries.name: Saparata crowned King
entries.outcome: Second King of Unstable; new players killed on sight; Parrot exiled.

entries.name: Arachn1d dethroned and killed
entries.outcome: Killed by yungyx.

entries.name: Spoke takes the Totem of NULL
entries.outcome: Spoke leads the NULL.

entries.name: NULL captures a Cindercrest stronghold
entries.outcome: Saparata sends ShoeBilly with an army to reclaim it.
